preconditions.description: The number of rows n is between 1 and 500 inclusive.
The number of columns m is between 1 and 500 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a[i][j] <= 1023 for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: Each element a[i][j] in the matrix is a non-negative integer between 0 and 1023 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'NIE' or (return_value.split()[0] == 'TAK' and len(return_value.split()) == n + 1 and all(1 <= int(c) <= m for c in return_value.split()[1:]))
postconditions.description: The output is either 'NIE' or 'TAK' followed by n integers, each between 1 and m inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'NIE' or (return_value.split()[0] == 'TAK' and int(return_value.split()[1]) == c1 and int(return_value.split()[2]) == c2 and ... and int(return_value.split()[n]) == cn and (a[0][c1-1] ^ a[1][c2-1] ^ ... ^ a[n-1][cn-1]) > 0)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'TAK c1 c2 ... cn', then the bitwise XOR of the selected elements a[0][c1-1], a[1][c2-1], ..., a[n-1][cn-1] is strictly greater than zero.
